observations.text: H-JS-1 RESULT: desanitize RULED OUT client-side (zero call sites in 24 chunks; outputs reach only React-escaped text children). redirectUrl->window.location.assign() CONFIRMED with NO client-side validation on 4 paths in signin.f7b86212.js (login @19975, OTP @12987, preauth @35931, passkey redirectUri @33062). Server reflection of attacker input UNTESTED.

H-REDIR-1 RESULT: open-redirect lead verified client-side; exploitability hinges on server echoing referral (window.location.href sent with login/preauth/otp requests). Needs live form submission; login POST currently 404s.

H-CFG-1 RESULT: /login_config verbatim dump captured (password-only, sso:[], oauth:[] , passkey empty, captchaChecking 1, apiVersion 28, no LDAP/SAML fields). Zero Set-Cookie on /login and /register GETs. Full CSP/HSTS/XFO header set captured verbatim; no Server or X-Accellion-Version headers.

H-ERR-1 RESULT: POST /rest/users/actions/login -> 404 {"message":"Not found"} (no credential evaluation). POST /rest/users/register -> 405 Allow: GET, DELETE, PUT (registration API unreachable). Doubled-scheme header observed: X-Accellion-Location: https://https://.... Wrong-user vs wrong-password UNTESTED.

ROUTE MAP: /login /register / -> 200 SPA shells. /rest/ -> 404. /rest/index.html -> 302 -> /login?LoginRedir=%2Frest%2Findex.html. All other probed paths -> 302 /error?status=404 -> 200. /rest/profiles (User Roles doc) -> 401. No 403s, no 429/503 anywhere.
